title.en: Ideal op-amp, parameters and virtual ground
title.kn: ಆದರ್ಶ ಆಪ್-ಆಂಪ್, ನಿಯತಾಂಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವರ್ಚುವಲ್ ಗ್ರೌಂಡ್

hook.en: Engineers design op-amp circuits by pretending the op-amp is perfect: infinite gain, infinite input resistance, zero output resistance. The answers come out almost exactly right.
hook.kn: ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್‌ಗಳು ಆಪ್-ಆಂಪ್ ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣವೆಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಿ ಮಂಡಲ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ: ಅನಂತ ವರ್ಧನೆ, ಅನಂತ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ರೋಧ, ಶೂನ್ಯ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ರೋಧ. ಉತ್ತರಗಳು ಬಹುತೇಕ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: List the characteristics of an ideal op-amp
Define offset voltage, bias current, offset current and slew rate

narration.en: Engineers design op-amp circuits by pretending the op-amp is perfect: infinite gain, infinite input resistance, zero output resistance. The answers come out almost exactly right.
narration.kn: ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್‌ಗಳು ಆಪ್-ಆಂಪ್ ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣವೆಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಿ ಮಂಡಲ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ: ಅನಂತ ವರ್ಧನೆ, ಅನಂತ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ರೋಧ, ಶೂನ್ಯ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ರೋಧ. ಉತ್ತರಗಳು ಬಹುತೇಕ ನಿಖರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: An ideal op-amp has infinite open-loop gain, infinite input resistance (no input current), zero output resistance, infinite bandwidth, infinite CMRR, infinite slew rate and zero output when the inputs are equal (no offset). A real IC 741 has an open-loop gain of about $2\times10^5$, input resistance about 2 MΩ, output resistance about 75 Ω, CMRR about 90 dB, slew rate 0.5 V/µs and a unity-gain bandwidth of about 1 MHz.

points.en: Ideal: A, Rin, BW, CMRR, SR all infinite
741: A ≈ 2 × 10⁵, Rin ≈ 2 MΩ, Rout ≈ 75 Ω, SR = 0.5 V/µs

narration.en: An ideal op-amp has infinite gain and input resistance and zero output resistance. The 741 has a gain of about two lakh and an input resistance of two megohms.
narration.kn: ಆದರ್ಶ ಆಪ್-ಆಂಪ್‌ಗೆ ಅನಂತ ವರ್ಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ರೋಧ, ಶೂನ್ಯ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ರೋಧ. 741 ರ ವರ್ಧನೆ ಸುಮಾರು 2 × 10⁵, ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ರೋಧ 2 MΩ.

narration.en: On the board: ideal op-amp and virtual ground.

say.en: Compare the ideal op-amp with the real IC 741. The 741 comes surprisingly close on most counts.
Because the open-loop gain is so large, a few volts of output need only microvolts between the inputs. The two inputs are at almost the same voltage.

text.en: With feedback, V− ≈ V+. If V+ is grounded,
V− ≈ 0 V but takes no current: virtual ground

body.en: Input offset voltage is the small DC voltage that must be applied between the inputs to make the output zero. Input bias current is the average of the two input currents, $I_B = (I_{B1} + I_{B2})/2$; input offset current is their difference, $|I_{B1} - I_{B2}|$. Slew rate is the maximum rate of change of output voltage; a sine of peak $V_p$ at frequency f needs $SR \ge 2\pi f V_p$. With negative feedback and a huge gain, $V_+ - V_- = V_o/A \approx 0$, so the two inputs stay at nearly the same voltage. If $V_+$ is grounded, $V_-$ is at 0 V but draws no current: this is the virtual ground.

points.en: Virtual ground: 0 V, but no current to ground

narration.en: Slew rate is the fastest the output can change. With negative feedback the two inputs sit at the same voltage, giving a virtual ground at the inverting input.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಲೂ ದರ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದಾದ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ವೇಗ. ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತವೆ; ಇದೇ ವರ್ಚುವಲ್ ಗ್ರೌಂಡ್.

caption.en: Slew-rate limit: the largest frequency an op-amp can deliver without distortion, fmax = SR/(2πVp), plotted against the peak output Vp.

tryThis.en: With the 741 (0.5 V/µs) and Vp = 10 V, read fmax.
Find the frequency at which the ratio passes 1: above it the sine turns triangular.
Halve the output amplitude. What happens to fmax?

problem.en: An IC 741 has a slew rate of 0.5 V/µs. Find the highest frequency at which it can give an undistorted sine output of 10 V peak.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. An IC 741 has a slew rate of 0.5 V/µs. Find the highest frequency at which it can give an undistorted sine output of 10 V peak.

problem.en: The two input bias currents of an op-amp are 90 nA and 70 nA. Find the input bias current and the input offset current.

narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆದರ್ಶ ಆಪ್-ಆಂಪ್: ಅನಂತ A, Rin, BW, CMRR; ಶೂನ್ಯ Rout. IB = ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಪ್ರವಾಹಗಳ ಸರಾಸರಿ; Ios = ಅವುಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ. ಸ್ಲೂ ದರ fmax = SR/(2πVp) ಅನ್ನು ಮಿತಿಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ V+ ≈ V−: ವರ್ಚುವಲ್ ಗ್ರೌಂಡ್.
